artworks.title: Telephus Frieze: King Teuthras finds Auge on the shore (Pergamon Altar, panel 10)
artworks.description: Panel 10 of the Pergamon Altar's Telephus frieze: King Teuthras discovers Auge stranded on the Mysian shore — the reception that plants Arcadian Auge at his Caicus court and sets the Pergamene dynastic myth in motion. Now in the Pergamonmuseum, Berlin.

artworks.title: The Marriage of Telephus and Auge prevented
artworks.description: Burney's Met drawing stages the interrupted wedding at Teuthras' Mysian court — the king who would marry Auge to Telephus without knowing they are mother and son, until recognition breaks the rite.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus' Telephus cycle — Teuthras as king of Mysia who receives Auge and later adopts (or hosts) Telephus, the hero wounded by Achilles.

popCulture.title: Teuthras
popCulture.description: King of Mysia who took in Auge and raised Telephus — the court behind Pergamon's claim to a Heraclid foundation.
